title: Air density — ef_air_density
text: $$\rho_{air} = \frac{1000\, P}{1.01\, T\, R}$$ \(R = 287\) J kg-1 K-1 (specific gas constant dry air) factor 1000 converting kPa Pa. FAO-56 (chapter 2, box 6) writes \(T_{Kv} = 1.01 (T + 273)\) \(T\) degrees Celsius; EarthFlux takes \(T\) K, equivalent using 273.15 instead 273 (relative difference 5e-4; decision SH-08). normative coefficients 1.01 287 kept literals equation (decision WF-14). Missing values propagate. Infinite values values outside domain raise error class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error). Verification status: VERIFICADA content FAO-56 (chapter 2, box 6). use METRIC CANDIDATA: SEBAL Idaho manual computes air density \(T_a = T_s - dT\) (Waters et al., 2002, p. 31, step 6), corroborates temperature used , print density equation (METRIC implementations use variant pressure standard atmosphere \(T_a\), 0.6 % higher).

text: pressure $$P = 101.3 \left(\frac{293 - 0.0065 z}{293}\right)^{5.26}$$ \(z\) elevation [m] \(P\) kPa (FAO-56, chapter 3, Eq. 7). FAO-56 states effect pressure evapotranspiration small mean value location sufficient. Missing values (NA, NaN) propagate output without errors warnings. elevation must numeric (double integer) non-empty. Infinite values elevations 45 076.92 m raise error class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error). plausible elevation range study area checked (threshold documented reference).
